# PREVENTION OF PROSTHETIC JOINT INFECTION BEFORE DENTAL PROCEDURES

Dental procedures are not associated with an increased risk of prosthetic joint infection. The routine use of antimicrobial prophylaxis before dental procedures in patients with prosthetic joints is not recommended. Good dental health should be maintained in patients with prosthetic joints and dental infections should be treated promptly.

For more information contact Infectious Diseases.
